boundary: Existing empty pass execution in a warm host; compilation and process startup excluded. Measures per-invocation setup/cleanup, not a useful workload or a full gap attribution.
stoppingRule: One unchanged micro warm lane only; no repeat, retuning, second lane or new producer. Inconclusive timing stays inconclusive.
setupCorrection: Initial catalog filter omitted .control suffix; stopped before verification/timing. Retain completed baseline build; continue candidate build without restarting old service.
